posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
Musicals exist in the liminal space of the intersection of serious and silly, so you may be both or either as you desire.

And, going the "everyone's compelled to dance and sing" route raises the amusing question of who would get a kick out of it and who'd be annoyed, and who'd be good at it and who'd be terribly tone-deaf. And who'd be the next Gene Kelly and who has two left feet. (Bonus for any characters for whom these three axes do not synergize.)
